configuration: ADR-0014, 30 mm cylinder, 81-trial production-primitive tolerance campaign
finding: The primary measured blocker is contact-descend terminal feasibility, not perception: 69/81 trials failed IK before close. Of the five descents that executed, observed contact was table interference or one-finger contact with a non-target cylinder; no bilateral target contact formed.
inference_boundary: The report does not identify a final corrective geometry or planner change. It establishes that any corrective action must first make a collision-safe terminal descend physically feasible and avoid table/non-target contact, then remeasure the full envelope.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not relax bilateral, attach, reset, or perception gate thresholds.
Do not use supervision as an online motion or contact input.
Do not run round-trip or WRONG_OBJECT acceptance while the reachability gate is NO_GO.
